what: brief-lints.md Levels: blaze::error_debug is deny. It is registered in blaze-lints (blaze/error_debug.rs, no-fallback-front-lints-errors, ra clean) at Allow by default. Two steps so no lane's build stops on existing hits: (1) on the next blaze-lints run, lint the workspace once with `--warn=blaze::error_debug` and send the hit count and sites to blaze-v2:=no-fallback-front (we fix them or queue them to their owners); (2) once it is 0, add `error_debug = "deny"` under `[workspace.metadata.blaze.lints]` in the root Cargo.toml (next to `hot_alloc = "warn"`, line 35).
